acceptedInterpretation: B-edb8 must deliver the full parent-roadmap totality implementation described by M1-M8: red/repro tests first, state model, rollup evaluator, claim consumer, B-5082 binding, CLI/lifecycle projection, migration/rollout, and certification. notes: Prevents scope shrinkage from all eight milestones to a single implementation slice.
